abstract: A case of choriocarcinoma of the testis metastatic to the skin is reported. In this case report the primary tumor was first diagnosed by the histopathologic findings in the cutaneous biopsy of a single nodule that appeared on the chest, with both syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic cells in the metastatic solid tumor islands. Using peroxidase-antiperoxidase techniques, beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG) was positive within the cytoplasm of syncytiotrophoblastic cells. The patient was treated with orchiectomy, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. With these measures there was a decrease of chorionic gonadotropin serum levels to normal limits and 2 years after this treatment there is no evidence of recurrence.
abstract_ja: 精巣絨毛癌が皮膚に転移した症例を報告する。原発腫瘍は、胸部に出現した単一の皮膚結節の皮膚生検組織所見で、合胞体栄養膜細胞と細胞性栄養膜細胞の両方を含む転移性充実性腫瘍巣として初めて診断された。ペルオキシダーゼ-抗ペルオキシダーゼ法により、合胞体栄養膜細胞の細胞質内でβ-hCGが陽性であった。患者は精巣摘除術、化学療法、放射線療法を受けた。これらの治療により血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値は正常範囲まで低下し、2年後の時点で再発の所見は認められていない。
